overview: Four layout categories; obtain a dimensioned unit sheet.
research.locationNote: Arjan, Dubai. The original Mykonos development is a separate project in Dubai Studio City.
research.priceNote: Developer references differ: AED 426,000 on the main page, AED 998,000 for studios and AED 1.9M for one-bedroom homes. Original factsheet: AED 649,000; Property Finder launch reference: AED 746,973. No available-unit quote verified.
research.paymentNote: Original five-year schedule includes monthly and additional payments. Confirm current dates; Property Finder’s headline and FAQ disagree.
research.handoverNote: SAMANA’s current FAQ estimates Q1 2027. Property Finder instead retains April 2026 and a Ready label; neither establishes certified completion of a selected home.
